column1: # The rectangles of the area asked of a source (ADR-0038, the plan's ticket 03): each line a map's
# projection and a layer's, as Forager's frontend writes them, and a map's extent in the first as
# minx, miny, maxx, maxy, tab-separated. The reader crates/cli/tests/conformance/mapserver_proj.c
# projects each through MapServer's msProjectRect in the noise run; the record mapserver-rects.tsv
# beside it is its output. Each group names the branch of msProjectRect it takes.
# misc/quoting.map's extent asked of its layer in EPSG:3978, and the way back: the sides and the
# the whole world in longitude and latitude, into Web Mercator and into another projection
# a rectangle of no size, and one of no width
# sides that leave the projection's domain: the horizon found along them
# no point of the sides reprojects: the grid, and no point of it either
# a projection whose origin is a pole, into longitude and latitude: the pole inside the extent,
